text:
anya: FYI hitting a goroutine leak in the Go SDK generator when cancelling immediately after the first token in the sampleapp onboarding flow.
carter: ugh, can you share a tiny repro and go version?
anya: go1.20. repro: start generator, consume one token, call cancel(), wait. pprof shows goroutines stuck. snippet below.

```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
gen, err := client.NewGenerator(ctx, &gen.Config{Model: "xsmall"})
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
// read one token
tok, _ := gen.Next()
cancel() // cancel right after first token
// gen.Close() maybe not called in sample
```

lina: saw same on linux. recv loop seems blocked on socket read during handshake and doesn't check ctx.Done(), so goroutine stays alive after cancel.
carter: makes sense. handshake/read loop waits for server frames and only exits on EOF. I can try adding a select that watches ctx.Done().
morgan: this is a big onboarding UX problem. Many users copy the sampleapp pattern (one gen per request) and we'll leak goroutines. Can we add a test that cancels mid-stream and also update the README with cancellation best-practice?
carter: branch opened with fixes: check ctx.Done() during handshake and in recv loop; make gen.Close() idempotent. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/pull/412
devex-bot: CI started for PR #412  unit tests passed, integration flaky; re-run queued.
sam: added an integration-style test that cancels after the first token (short/integration). Also updated sampleapp README with a short snippet explaining preferred cancellation pattern and to always call gen.Close() in defer.
anya: verified locally  no leak, goroutine count returns to baseline within ~2s after cancel.
morgan: looks good. please backport to 0.9.x and add a small changelog blurb about generator cancellation fixes.
carter: will do backport and changelog. also added an internal metric/log when generator goroutines exceed 5s active after ctx cancellation so we can detect regressions.
anya: thanks all. DX note for docs team: update the streaming quickstart to show a cancel pattern and emphasize defer gen.Close() for sample apps.
carter: adding a short entry to the release notes and pinging docs. merging after green CI.
anya: great work — should reduce a lot of onboarding friction.
